tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground on every product. Warm, brown-shifted; never #000, never a cool grey.

tokens.name: bg-elev
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, stat cells, the sidebar's active state ground. Lifted by tier and a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: bg-code
tokens.usage: Terminal, readout and code bodies.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Pressed-in surfaces: inline code, chips, filter buttons, chart tracks, loading shimmer.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline at rest. Stat grids are drawn by a 1px gap over this colour.

tokens.name: border-hi
tokens.usage: Hairlines on interactive or hovered elements, and control outlines.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, figures and headings on bg, bg-elev, bg-code and bg-inset. 12.8:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, axis ticks, table headers on every surface. Clears AA on all four grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: window titles, timestamps, copy hints. Fails AA in dark (3.36 on bg), so it never carries a fact, a link or body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brick, the one accent: kickers, stat labels and units, links, the current nav item, focus rings, the primary action, a chart's lead series, a 3D instrument's lit glass. 5.26:1 on bg dark; 5.14:1 or better on every light surface.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pale-accent-bg (badges, eyebrows, pressed chips). Brick on its own wash fails AA; this measures 9.4:1 dark, 7.55:1 light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill (primary buttons). Dark text on dark-theme brick is 5.26:1; white on it would be 3.4:1 and fail.

tokens.name: pale-accent-bg
tokens.usage: The accent wash behind badges, the current nav item, pressed chips and the hero eyebrow.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: The only red, and it only reports bad news: a failed read, a failing check, a negative figure, a blocked chain. Never decoration, never a heading.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pale-bad-bg.

tokens.name: pale-bad-bg
tokens.usage: Wash behind a bad badge or a failed panel's notice.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, live, verified: the live dot, an in-scope list title, a passing check. Washed, never saturated; always beside a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded, stale, waiting: a snapshot instead of live, a lagging cursor. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: metal-copper
tokens.usage: 3D material only: copper trim, coil windings, valve anodes. Never UI text or a fill on the page.

tokens.name: metal-brass
tokens.usage: 3D material only: bezels, knobs, nameplates. Polished brass, never gold; scarce, under a tenth of an instrument.

tokens.name: metal-iron
tokens.usage: 3D material only: cases, chassis, the dark metal an instrument is mostly made of.

tokens.name: metal-verdigris
tokens.usage: 3D material only: oxidised copper on an old part. One small patch per scene at most.

tokens.name: material-bakelite
tokens.usage: 3D material only: radio cabinets, terminal cases, knobs that are not brass. Dark, warm, a little gloss.

tokens.name: glow-valve
tokens.usage: 3D emissive only: a lit valve filament, a nixie digit, a CRT's phosphor in brick. Bloom picks it up; nothing else in a scene should be this bright.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one claim at the top of a landing page or a product overview. Scales with clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4.4rem) at the 18px root.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: One process, from RPC to this page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A stat cell's number, tabular numerals, the unit set apart in mono brick.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Live, filterable, and yours to reproduce.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section title, at most 60ch, in text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The page loads every liquidation once, then filters in your browser.
styles.usage: All running text and table cells (0.875rem at the 112.5% root).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes under a card, secondary copy (0.75rem).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The stamped plate above every section, stat label and unit: uppercase, brick (0.625rem).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badges, chips, table headers, the topbar's page name (0.6875rem).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminals, readouts and install lines. A transcript is always real output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a stat cell, between a label and its figure.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and grid gaps, the minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section side gutter on desktop, card padding on landing pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section lede and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Topbar height (4.5rem); section rhythm floor on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, the install line.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, terminals, readouts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, the live chip and status dots only; never a large container.

shadow.note: Elevation is a surface tier plus a hairline. The one shadow sits under a floating readout or terminal over a 3D scene.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: A readout or terminal floating over a 3D hero. Nowhere else; never a card lift.
